get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific company.
get.description:
Returns the complete company profile including configuration settings
and operational parameters. This information is used for company
management and system configuration.

Possible errors:
- NOT_FOUND if the company ID doesn't exist
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the company to retrieve
Required. Must be a valid company ID

post.summary: Lists companies based on specified criteria.
post.description:
Results are paginated and can be used for system administration
and multi-company management scenarios. Companies are returned
in alphabetical order by name.

Possible errors:
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if pagination parameters are invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ListCompaniesRequest encapsulates parameters for retrieving companies.

id.description: IANA Time Zone Database time zone, e.g. "America/New_York".

version.description: Optional. IANA Time Zone Database version number, e.g. "2019a".

typeTimeZone.description:
Represents a time zone from the
[IANA Time Zone Database](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

id.title:
Unique identifier for the company
Format: "cmp_" followed by random characters

rawId.title: Original raw identifier for the company in product

name.title:
Legal name of the company
Used in official communications and documents

country.title:
Country where the company is registered
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

timezone.title:
Primary timezone for company operations
Used for scheduling and reporting

v1Company.description:
Company represents a business entity in the system.
Companies are the top-level organizational units that contain multiple
business locations, staff members, and service offerings. Each company
has its own configuration settings and operational parameters.

pagination.title:
Pagination parameters for handling large result sets
Required to manage data volume efficiently

v1ListCompaniesRequest.description: ListCompaniesRequest encapsulates parameters for retrieving companies.

nextPageToken.title:
Token for retrieving the next page of results
Empty if there are no more results

companies.title:
List of companies matching the request criteria
May be empty if no companies match

v1ListCompaniesResponse.description: ListCompaniesResponse contains the paginated list of companies.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.
